claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a blue plastic chemical drum with markings; photos do not confirm it was used for water or is currently empty.
Photos show printed markings but they are not fully readable; no certification/grade label is confirmed.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of prior contents; only general exterior condition is visible.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: Witness reports drum appears intact, no visible leaks, and lid/bung/cap present.

risks.risk: Capacity/volume is unknown, so pricing could be wrong if it’s a smaller or larger drum than expected.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the capacity/volume marking (e.g., liters/gal) on the side, fully readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-capacity used plastic drum (worst-case: smaller size) with no guarantee of suitability.

risks.risk: Previous contents may not be water/food-safe (chemical residue or non-food-grade use).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full product/chemical history label or any UN/grade markings on the drum, plus a photo of the inside (opening) showing cleanliness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-food/unknown-contents drum (worst-case: not suitable for drinking/food use).

risks.risk: Lid seal and bung thread condition may be worn even if the exterior looks intact; could leak under pressure or during transport.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the bung/cap being tightened and a simple water-fill leak test (or at least a fill-and-wait clip).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing resealing/replacement of bung/lid (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed leak-proof).

risks.risk: Food-grade status may be claimed but not verifiable from photos; markings may be unclear or absent.
risks.proof: A clear, readable shot of any food-grade/NSF/FDA or relevant compliance markings on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used plastic drum (worst-case: not certified food-grade).

risks.risk: Accessories/fitment are unknown (e.g., whether it includes the correct bung, liner, or any tap/spigot).
risks.proof: Photos of the bung/cap assembly and any included parts laid out, plus a shot of the drum opening.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drum-only with no accessories included.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the drum’s capacity/volume marking (fully readable).
Send a clear photo of the full side label/markings (including any grade/UN/chemical history text).
Send an inside photo through the opening (showing cleanliness/residue).
Send a short video of the bung/cap being tightened and confirm it stays sealed (simple water-fill leak test).
Confirm whether any accessories are included (bungs, liners, taps/spigots) and show them clearly.
response.reason: The witness confirms the drum’s general exterior condition (intact, no visible leaks) but key pricing drivers—capacity and whether it’s truly food-grade/previously water—are not readable or not shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be too uncertain.
